subject: Request: Audit telemetry package (MedicoSys) — redaction guidance
messages:
From: audit@medicosys.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Audit evidence request: activity logs + admin actions (Mar 1-15)

Hi Olga,

We need a package containing admin activity and operator telemetry for the period 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-15 for our SOC 2 re-assessment. Specifically:
- all admin console events (role changes, permission grants, API key creation/deletion)
- operator session traces and JWT issue/refresh logs
- request-level metadata for sign-in and token usage (IP, region, timestamp)

Requirements: CSV manifest of exported files, signed SHA256 checksums, and a short explanation of any redaction you perform. We cannot receive PII.

Can you confirm: (1) a safe export window, (2) redaction approach for email addresses and IPs, and (3) how you prefer to share the artifacts (S3 presigned, GDrive with restricted link, or secure file transfer)?

Thanks,
Mark Reyes
Lead Auditor — MedicoSys Compliance
---
Attachment: medicosys_request_form_20270412.pdf (form)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: audit@medicosys.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request: activity logs + admin actions (Mar 1-15)

Hi Mark — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Neha (Security) and Vivek (Ops) so we can confirm delivery method and redaction. Quick notes up front:
- We can produce a time-bounded NDJSON slice of the admin-event ledger and a CSV manifest with checksums.
- Redaction: we prefer pseudonymization for internal operator_ids (salted hash) and IP truncation to /24 for external IPs unless you require full IPs for forensic analysis.
- Transfer: we usually deliver via a short-lived, account-scoped S3 presigned bucket with encrypted objects (SSE-KMS).

I will create a minimal evidence manifest and proposed redaction map and send for approval before export.

Olga Petrov
Senior Account Security Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: medicosys_evidence_manifest_draft.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, audit@medicosys.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request: activity logs + admin actions (Mar 1-15)

On Tue, Apr 12, 2027 at 10:03 AM olga_petrov@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Mark — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Neha (Security) and Vivek (Ops) so we can confirm delivery method and redaction.
>
> I will create a minimal evidence manifest and proposed redaction map and send for approval before export.

Hi all,

A few clarifying Qs from security:
1) Does MedicoSys require full source IPs for correlation with firewall logs, or will a truncated /24 suffice for your control objective? If you need full IPs we must route the export through an approved legal/contract flow (PII carve-out).
2) For operator identifiers: we will replace usernames and email addresses with salted SHA256 hashes and include a separate mapping file (kept out of the package) only if you produce a signed legal request.
3) Retention note: our default activity ledger keeps seven years of metadata; slices are reproducible but live keys to decrypt KMS-wrapped objects will be rotated on schedule. If you want us to keep copies beyond our standard retention for the audit, we need an evidence escrow to be signed.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Olga: produce manifest + redaction_map (CSV) showing what fields will be transformed.
- Vivek: confirm export pipeline, encryption (SSE-KMS key id), and presigned link TTL.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, audit@medicosys.com
Date: 2027-04-13T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request: activity logs + admin actions (Mar 1-15)

Olga / Neha / Mark,

We can deliver the export as gzipped NDJSON objects split by day with a companion CSV manifest and SHA256 sums. Delivery options (ranked by security):
1) S3 presigned objects in a customer-scoped bucket (recommended). TTL = 72 hours by default; we can shorten to 24 hours on request. Objects encrypted with SSE-KMS (key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/xxx).
2) Managed secure share (Box/ShareFile) with enforced download MFA.
3) Direct SFTP push to a MedicoSys endpoint (requires scheduling + firewall whitelisting).

Notes on redaction:
- We will pseudonymize emails and user IDs with salted hash; salt stored in our internal secret vault.
- IPs will be truncated to /24 by default; if full IPs are required for incident correlation we will produce them but only if MedicoSys signs a PII addendum.

I attached a sample manifest and a small sample slice (first 24 hours) for validation. If MedicoSys approves the sample redaction map, we will schedule the full export on Apr 14 evening (non-peak).

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: activity_slice_sample_20270301.ndjson (sample)
Attachment: sample_manifest.csv

From: audit@medicosys.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: legal+procurement@clearsafe.io
Date: 2027-04-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request: activity logs + admin actions (Mar 1-15)

Thanks, Olga / Neha / Vivek — the sample looks good. A couple of final confirmations before you run the full export: 
- MedicoSys requests full (untruncated) IPs for correlation with perimeter logs. We will sign the PII addendum — please send it to legal+procurement@clearsafe.io and cc me.
- We prefer S3 presigned delivery with TTL=24h and SSE-KMS. Please include the KMS key alias and the object prefix in the manifest.
- For operator mapping: we do NOT need the raw mapping file. The salted hashes are sufficient for our control tests.

If you can send the PII addendum this afternoon, we will countersign and expect the export to arrive by Apr 15 (EOD).

Regards,
Mark Reyes
Lead Auditor — MedicoSys Compliance
